subject: Request: Combined trial extension + credit bundle for Solarlex POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@solarlex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Solarlex Procurement <procurement@solarlex.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial usage spike — ask for extension + credits

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick setup last week. The team ran targeted ingestion with our older meter data and usage spiked faster than expected (~2.6M tokens over 48 hours). We still want to move forward but need runway to finish the ingestion and two downstream evaluations. Can Redwood provide an extra 30 days on the trial and a one-time credit of $15k to cover this surge?

If you can get procurement on board with formal confirmation this week, we can sign the SOW and commit to a Q1 pilot volume. Attaching a short usage snapshot for context.

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platforms
Solarlex Energy

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial usage spike — ask for extension + credits

Liam — thanks for the data, that helps. I can provision an additional 30 days from our side fast, but the $15k credit is above my authorization. Looping Marissa (revenue ops) and Aditya (enterprise sales) to scope approval.

Next steps from us:
- Marissa — can you confirm if we can do a one-time $15k trial credit + 30d extension for a new deal commitment?
- Aditya — happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if needed.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Trial usage spike — ask for extension + credits

Jonas / Aditya — quick read: Solarlex looks like a mid-sized energy software company with clear pilot-to-prod intent. We typically approve trial extensions up to 30 days. For credits, one-time promotional credits at this size (>$10k) need exec sign-off because of ARR/discount guardrails.

To move this forward, please provide:
- A short MA-plan (mutual action plan) showing milestones in the 30d extension (ingest, eval, decision).
- Expected ARR if the pilot succeeds (ballpark).
- Any procurement contract timeline (they mentioned signing SOW).

Soojin — can you review their compliance/corporate procurement ask in parallel? If we need an exception, I'll escalate to Revenue Ops leadership and include a concise business rationale for execs.

-Marissa
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Soojin — forwarding my note to include a concise exec-level ask.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Exec ask: Solarlex — $15k credit + 30d extension

Executive summary for approval (please paste into the ticket):
- Customer: Solarlex Energy (deal D-2027-0934)
- Ask: One-time $15,000 promotional credit applied to hosted usage; 30-day trial extension (no change to list price)
- Rationale: Unexpected ingestion surge during validation caused accelerated token consumption. Customer remains engaged and ready to sign SOW (attached). Approving preserves momentum and converts pilot -> committed pilot (expected ARR: $120k/year).
- Risk/Precedent: < $20k one-time credit is within promotional budget but requires exec approval due to contract flow. Credit should be applied to hosted account and expire if no conversion within 60 days after extension.
- Suggested approval: $15k credit, 30d extension, conditional on signed SOW within 14 days and documented mutual action plan.

Proposed approvers: Marissa (rev ops), VP Revenue (Soojin), Head of Sales (Aditya) — if green, we route to the Exec approval queue and capture sign-off.

Aditya

(Internal note: I've attached the usage snapshot and SOW to the HubSpot deal and started a DocuSign envelope.)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@solarlex.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: Solarlex credit + extension (exec sign-off)

All — thank you for the materials and MA-plan. I've reviewed the case and approve the following exception:

- One-time promotional credit of $15,000 to be applied against Solarlex's hosted usage (account credit).
- 30-day trial extension starting 2027-11-10.
- Conditions: credit expires if the SOW is not countersigned within 14 days of the extension start; customer must agree to the mutual action plan milestones (ingest complete, two eval runs, go/no-go decision).

Marissa will confirm application of the credit and Soojin will record the exception in the promo ledger for audit. Jonas — please confirm SOW countersignature timeline with Liam and update the HubSpot deal once signed.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
